label.text: Extra Note Lane: Ring notes will appear in an additional lane in between the down and up arrows. Ring Notes are the only notes that will appear on this lane. On PC, press the SPACE key to hit them. On mobile, simply tap the ring.
Miss Penalty: If you miss a standard note while holding at least one ring, you will lose a ring instead of taking health damage.
Conservation: Save your rings for difficult sections! Having a stockpile of rings acts as a shield during intense charting patterns.
Phantom Notes: Phantom notes will NOT take away your rings if you miss them. Do not waste your rings trying to avoid phantom notes.
Press SPACE, ENTER, or click 'Start Song' to begin.
